mapper.insert: INSERT INTO statistics (id, feedback_id, grid_member_id, so2, co, pm25, aqi, confirm_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{feedbackId}, #{gridMemberId}, #{so2}, #{co}, #{pm25}, #{aqi}, #{confirmTime})
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, gm.real_name AS grid_member_name, gp.name AS province_name, gc.name AS city_name FROM statistics s LEFT JOIN grid_member gm ON s.grid_member_id = gm.id LEFT JOIN aqi_feedback f ON s.feedback_id = f.id LEFT JOIN grid_province gp ON f.province_id = gp.id LEFT JOIN grid_city gc ON f.city_id = gc.id ORDER BY s.confirm_time DESC

SELECT s.*, gm.real_name AS grid_member_name, gp.name AS province_name, gc.name AS city_name FROM statistics s LEFT JOIN grid_member gm ON s.grid_member_id = gm.id LEFT JOIN aqi_feedback f ON s.feedback_id = f.id LEFT JOIN grid_province gp ON f.province_id = gp.id LEFT JOIN grid_city gc ON f.city_id = gc.id WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT gp.name AS provinceName, COUNT(*) AS total FROM statistics s LEFT JOIN aqi_feedback f ON s.feedback_id = f.id LEFT JOIN grid_province gp ON f.province_id = gp.id GROUP BY gp.id, gp.name ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN s.aqi BETWEEN 0 AND 50 THEN '优' WHEN s.aqi BETWEEN 51 AND 100 THEN '良' WHEN s.aqi BETWEEN 101 AND 150 THEN '轻度污染' WHEN s.aqi BETWEEN 151 AND 200 THEN '中度污染' WHEN s.aqi BETWEEN 201 AND 300 THEN '重度污染' ELSE '严重污染' END AS level, COUNT(*) AS total FROM statistics s GROUP BY level ORDER BY MIN(s.aqi)
